hypothesis: The SIC-C-c covering meta-theorem (Lean-verified as StructuralIntelligenceMathlib.sicc_covering_meta and sicc_covering_poly) predicts n_emp(K, delta) = c * K * log(K / delta) for a single class-independent constant c. On the controlled continuous space (2-D Gaussian world with rotational latent quantised to a K-bin eps-cover), the coupon-collector recovery event (each of the K eps-cover cells hit at least once in N uniform iid samples) has smallest recovery-achieving N whose ratio n_emp / (K * log(K/delta)) is stable to within 20% across K in {8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256}, and empirically approaches 1 from below at large K.

controls.description: Recovery probability P(all K cells hit in N iid samples) is computed by the classical inclusion-exclusion sum over K+1 terms; no Monte Carlo, no seed dependence, exact in double precision at K <= 256.
n_emp is defined as the smallest N with P(recovery) >= 1 - delta, verified by checking that P(recovery, n_emp - 1) < 1 - delta at every K in the sweep.
For every K, n_emp >= K (recovering K distinct cells requires at least K samples). Verified directly.
P(recovery) is nondecreasing in N by a coupling argument (extra samples never uncollect a cell); the binary search relies on this monotonicity.

gates.criterion: (max c_fitted - min c_fitted) / mean c_fitted <= 0.20 across K in {8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256}.
For every K, exact recovery probability at n_emp is >= 1 - delta = 0.95.
For every K, exact recovery probability at n_emp - 1 is < 1 - delta = 0.95 (n_emp is not one larger than needed).
